items.t: In Albion, Maple Ridge, houses sold at a median of $1,244,000 across 78 sales, and the middle half closed between $990,000 and $1,379,750. The median house sat 19 days and sold for 97.7% of list.
Albion, Maple Ridge: 29 townhomes sold at a median of $745,000, with the middle half between $699,900 and $800,500. The median townhome took 22 days to sell and closed at 98.2% of list.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Albion compares with the rest of Maple Ridge

items.t: Of 9 Maple Ridge sub-areas with 5 or more house sales, Albion ranks 4th highest at $1,244,000; the range is $1,039,000 (Southwest Maple Ridge) to $1,421,500 (Silver Valley). Cottonwood ($1,195,000) sits just below and Northwest Maple Ridge ($1,250,000) sits just above.

Townhomes in Albion have the 4th highest median of 8 Maple Ridge sub-areas, $745,000. Southwest Maple Ridge is lowest at $610,000 and Thornhill highest at $862,000. East Central ($700,000) sits just below and Cottonwood ($750,000) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, townhomes are the newest homes selling in Albion, Maple Ridge (median 2016) and houses the oldest (median 2006), a gap of 10 years.
